title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a package-less action save on an object no package binds the name to writes the environment's own action
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNTugWasvhTMrtCZiFGrZYK)_
Fixes #34059

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches where a package-less save of a writable package's item is written; `skills/objectstack-platform` teaches only the managed base's `.custom` pair, whose refusals do not move.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：环境不带包名保存一个动作（`PUT /meta/action/NAME`，无 `?package=`）时，如果持有这个名字的包都把它绑在别的对象上，这次保存写成环境自己的动作行，绑在本次保存的对象上；包里的动作原地不动。
- 为什么改：维护者裁决 6902014292（方案 B）：动作按 ADR-0150 D4 的键 `(package, objectName, name)` 认定。以前这种保存被改写进那个包，把包的动作从 A 对象挪到 B 对象，回执还写着包名。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `metadata-protocol` 保存入口的一个判断，只对 `action` 生效；同对象保存、其它类型、托管（代码）包都照旧。BREAKING（收窄）：原来写进包的保存现在写成环境行；两个包分别绑在另外两个对象时，原来 409，现在写环境行。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts`（风险 hunk：无包保存地址处新增的 `environmentOwnAction` 分支，及文件末尾的 `actionHeldOnlyOnOtherObjects`）→ `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts`（新 describe `[ADR-0150 D4]`）→ `packages/qa/dogfood/test/action-save-packageless-other-object.dogfood.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts -t "ADR-0150 D4"`，预期 9 个用例全绿；在 main 上前 5 个红（回执写着包名，包的动作被挪走）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（ADR-0150 的修订注记另由席位以 skills 卡提交，本 PR 不碰 `docs/adr/**`）。

## What changes

ADR-0150 D4 keys an action `(package, objectName, name)`, and the ruling on #34059 (6902014292, option B) puts that key on the package-less save door. The publish-mode save door re-addressed a save naming no package into the one package whose active row holds the name (`packagelessAddress`), whatever object that package binds the name to, so the package's declaration moved onto the saved object.

- `saveMetaItemUnaudited` (publish mode, an authoring save naming no package) now asks `actionHeldOnlyOnOtherObjects` right after the address is read. For type `action` only, it narrows the item's active rows to those whose body binds the object the saved body binds (`boundObjectOf`, the owner-key reader the read side's `lookupArtifactItem` uses; object-less is its own key) and reads the address over them. When no package's row is left, no package holds this item: `packageId` stays empty and the save writes the package-unbound row. Every package's row is untouched.
- When at least one holder binds the saved object, nothing changes: the same-object save is still that package's customization (the generic re-address pinned at L234 of `protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts`), and two such holders are still refused `409`.
- A stored body that does not parse is read as binding the saved object, so it never drops a holder from the key.
- Not changed: every other type; a save naming a package; the draft save (`?mode=draft`, see Acceptance notes); managed (code) packages, which the door's sealed gate and the repository's store backstop refuse `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` before the address is read.

Every moved answer (writable `P`; `Q` a second writable package):

| Shape | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `P` on `invoice`, package-less save bound to `task` | `200`, receipt `package=P`; `P`'s row moved to `task` | `200`, receipt with no package; the environment's row on `task`, `P`'s row on `invoice` untouched |
| `P` on `invoice`, package-less object-less save | same move | the environment's object-less row |
| `P` on `invoice`, `Q` on `product`, save bound to `task` | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both | the environment's row on `task` |

Clause-② arm: narrowing (the first two rows move a written answer). The third row turns a refusal into a save; it is the same D4 key with zero holders at it, so it is listed here rather than left out.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts`, new top-level describe `[ADR-0150 D4] a package-less save of an ACTION on an object the holder does not bind`, beside the L234 generic re-address describe (which is unchanged): 5 negative pins (the receipt and stored rows; `?package=P` still serving `P`'s item on `invoice`; a second save editing the environment's row; object-less; two holders on two other objects) and 4 CONTROLs (same-object save re-addressed into `P`; the same with the environment's row already stored; a holder on each object still `409`; a managed code package's action still `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, nothing written).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/action-save-packageless-other-object.dogfood.test.ts` (new, real showcase boot over HTTP): the measured cell (receipt, `?package=P` read, `/actions/showcase_invoice/NAME` judging `P`'s declaration, `/actions/showcase_task/NAME` and `/actions/_env/showcase_task/NAME` judging the environment's), the same-object CONTROL, and the managed CONTROL (`showcase_mark_done` saved on `showcase_product`).

<details><summary>Premise re-measured on origin/main 571cf9082a (real showcase dev boot, SQLite)</summary>

```text
POST /packages com.probe.beta -> 201
PUT /meta/action/probe_approve_p?package=com.probe.beta (showcase_invoice) -> Saved ... (env-wide, package=com.probe.beta, state=active) [seq=1]
PUT /meta/action/probe_approve_p (showcase_task)                           -> Saved ... (env-wide, package=com.probe.beta, state=active) [seq=2]
GET ?package=com.probe.beta -> objectName showcase_task, label "Approve Env", _packageId com.probe.beta
POST /actions/_env/showcase_task/probe_approve_p -> 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
```

After the fix (same boot recipe, head with the fix): the second save answers `Saved ... (env-wide, state=active) [seq=2]`; `?package=com.probe.beta` serves `showcase_invoice` / "Approve P"; `/actions/showcase_invoice/...` judges P's target, `/actions/showcase_task/...` and `/actions/_env/showcase_task/...` the environment's, `/actions/_env/showcase_invoice/...` 404.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation readings (each mutation through ablation-replace.mjs, restored to blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- A1, the exception removed (anchor `if (type !== 'action' || address.candidates.length === 0) return false;` gains `|| name !== '__ablation_34059__'`): unit describe 5 failed / 4 passed, exactly the 5 negative pins red, e.g. `Expected: "Saved action 'approve_p' (env-wide, state=active) [seq=2]"`, `Received: "Saved action 'approve_p' (env-wide, package=com.qa.lanebapp, state=active) [seq=2]"`. (A first run had the second same-object CONTROL red too: it arranged the environment's row through the fix; it now seeds that row, and the re-run is the reading above.)
- A1 on dist (the dogfood suite reads `metadata-protocol`'s `dist/`): rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` marker present in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`; the measured-cell pin red (`expected 'Saved action ... (env-wide, package=com.example.qasaveother, state=active) [seq=2]' not to contain 'package='`), both CONTROLs green; restored, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` exit 0, tree clean.
- A2, the exception over-broad (`return atObject.candidates.length === 0 || name === 'approve_p';`): 3 failed / 6 passed, exactly the three same-object and `409` CONTROLs red.
- A3, the managed control: lifting the door's sealed gate alone (`refusePackagedBaseOverride` at the save door) kept it green, because the repository's store backstop (`SysMetadataRepository.assertAllowed`) refuses the same write with the same `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (stack read). With both lifted for the control's name: 1 failed / 8 passed, the managed CONTROL red.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The bare by-name read is not changed here, and it does not serve the environment's item.** After the fix, with `P`'s row on `showcase_invoice` and the environment's row on `showcase_task`, `GET /meta/action/NAME` (no `?package=`) and `GET /meta/action` serve `P`'s item; `?package=_env` answers `409` naming `P` and the environment. The same state reached in the other save order (the environment's save first, then `?package=P`, never through this door) reads the same on main, so it is the read side's seam (`packagelessContentPackage` takes the stored rows' one binding), not this door's. The dogfood pin therefore pins the read naming `P` and the action route, not the bare read. Reported to the seat with the #33904 listing half.
- **The draft twin is not changed.** A package-less `?mode=draft` save still inherits the package of the item's active rows (`SysMetadataRepository.resolveWriteHead`, `packagelessDraftAddress`), so a draft saved on `task` lands in `P` and its publish moves `P`'s action. Those two live outside this PR's file surface. Reported to the seat.
- **Two holders, one of them on the saved object** (`P` on `invoice`, `Q` on `task`, a save on `task`) is still `409` naming both, pinned as a CONTROL; under the D4 key it would be `Q`'s customization. Reported to the seat.
- The `SaveMetaItemRequest.packageId` description in `packages/spec` states the package-less address rule without the action exception. It is not edited here (outside this PR's surface). Reported to the seat.
- The ADR-0150 amendment note for object-bound actions is drafted in the report for the seat to file as a skills card; `docs/adr/**` is not touched.

## Verification

Head `0e5faaaa8a` (origin/main `98a4449f87` merged; the metadata-protocol full suite read at `32c7a1ca8e`, and after this merge the save door's two pin files and the typecheck re-run green), readings under the shared verify lock; the dogfood battery, the REST suite and every gate exit code are in the os-dev-report comment on #34059.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck` exit 0.
